note: P13-C-P0.1: the panel's DECLARED TAB INVENTORY. This file is what makes the §10 coverage law's unit a tab instead of a file (docs/contracts/coverage-allowlist.yaml carries the 'why'). A subsystem may only register a tab whose id is declared here; ui/panel/tab-registry.ts refuses anything else with the typed error 'unknown-tab-id' rather than dropping it. The inventory is additive-only: removing an id is a contract change, not an edit. Order is first-class because two tabs claiming the same order is a validation failure, not a tie-breaker.

reserved_orders.note: Orders are spaced by 10 so a later subsystem can insert between two tabs without renumbering (renumbering would break every bookmarked deep link). The frame renders in ascending order; the strip is a tablist, not a sort.
